title: The park service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be moved?
summary: President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.
contentText:
President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.

(Image credit: Andrew Caballero-Reynolds)
